quote: I'd been juggling four job sites with four sets of alerts. Orbit found me the same roles in one search — and the salary filter meant I stopped wasting evenings on listings that were never going to work.
name: Hannah R.

quote: Applied on my phone during a lunch break. Under a minute, no account, and I could actually track what happened afterwards. That's how it should work everywhere.
name: Marcus O.

quote: We're a 40-person firm with no ATS. The job was live the same morning and the applicant view is honestly better than the enterprise tool I used at my last company.
name: Priya S.

quote: Publishing the salary range felt uncomfortable. It shouldn't have — applications went up and the conversations got easier, because everyone already knew the number.
name: Daniel K.

quote: The alert emails only send genuinely new roles. I didn't realise how rare that is until the other boards' duplicates stopped.
name: Aisha B.

quote: Being able to see where a listing comes from builds trust. When it says 'via' a partner board, it says so — no pretending.
name: Tom W.

quote: Three screening questions replaced our first phone stage. We interviewed half as many people and hired faster.
name: Elena V.

quote: Saved a shortlist on the bus, applied from my laptop that evening, had an interview by Friday. The tracking alone is worth the account.
name: Josh M.
